atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: UnoCSS directive (via transformerDirectives) that inlines the CSS generated by one or more utility classes into the current rule, e.g. `@apply flex items-center;`.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: UnoCSS directive (via transformerDirectives) that generates a media query for the given breakpoint, e.g. `@screen md { ... }`.
